shortBio.en: Led Zeppelin vocalist; high-register hard-rock voice who continued solo and collaborative work after 1980.
shortBio.zh: Led Zeppelin 主唱；高音区 hard-rock 声线，1980 年后继续独唱与合作。

whyHub.en: Frontman as evolving person: arena vocal of the classic IV, then reinvention beyond the band logo.
whyHub.zh: 作为持续演化的主唱人物：经典四人的体育场人声，然后在乐队 logo 之外再发明。

body.en:
Born 1948. Zeppelin years define the mythic high vocal over blues/folk/epic forms. After Bonham’s death, solo albums and later collaborations (e.g. with Alison Krauss) refuse to freeze 1971.

Use this page to exit the band bubble into post-Zeppelin listening—same person, different frames.
body.zh:
1948 年生。Zeppelin 年代定义蓝调/民谣/史诗形式上的神话高音。Bonham 去世后，独唱专辑与后期合作（如与 Alison Krauss）拒绝冻结在 1971。

用本页离开乐队气泡进入后 Zeppelin 聆听——同一人，不同框架。

note.zh: 乐队之后的独唱与合作年代。
